items.headline: Red Robin Gourmet Burgers earnings missed by $0.15, revenue fell short of estimates By Investing.com
items.summary: Investing.com - Red Robin Gourmet Burgers (NASDAQ: RRGB) reported third quarter EPS of $-0.540, $0.15 worse than the analyst estimate of $-0.390. Revenue for the quarter came in at $232.1M versus the consensus estimate of $250.06M.

items.headline: Everpure Stock Jumps After Posting Earnings Beat
items.summary: Everpure (P) stock jumped after the enterprise data storage company reported fiscal third-quarter results that beat estimates and said it expects another strong quarter. Everpure earned an adjusted 86 cents per share from sales of $1.46 billion for the quarter ended Nov.
